description.narrative: Insatsen bereddes i en tidigare version av insatshanteringssystemet, varför dessa fält nu lämnas obesvarade och insatsen nu har avslutats.

International Vaccine Institute is an NGO aiming at making vaccines available in LICs in order to reduce the burden of childhood diseases and thus <5 mortality. Sida's core support is used to facilitate the start up of laboratories, provision of technical assistance to vaccine producers and regulators in the developing world, and to help reinforce the development of an international network.
